features.justification_quote: 16 turns is empirically enough room for the attractor to form... without spending tokens far past the point of diagnostic value

features.quote: `gave_up` (explicit abandonment language with no tool call)
features.justification_quote: legitimate end states and degradation symptoms — capturing them as stop reasons lets the analysis use them as signal

features.quote: `stalled_no_tool` (N consecutive turns with no parseable tool call)
features.justification_quote: persistent total parse failure is itself diagnostic and is captured by the `stalled_no_tool` stop reason
